settings.title: Your first tri bike
settings.text: Your first race is on the calendar and the borrowed road bike is holding you back. You need the right bike for your race distance — without overbuying.
settings.pick: SP · Shimano 105 — race-ready out of the box
settings.upgrade: Keep the stock wheels for season one and spend the savings on a proper fit — use the Fit Finder below so the size is right the first time.

settings.title: The age-grouper
settings.text: You’ve raced enough to know the bike leg is where your time hides, and the road-bike-with-clip-ons setup has hit its ceiling. Time for a dedicated tri bike.
settings.pick: SP · Shimano 105 or SRAM Rival AXS
settings.upgrade: Carbon race wheels are the classic next step — add a wheelset with your bike and the discount applies automatically in the cart.

settings.title: The comeback
settings.text: You raced in another phase of life and you’re coming back — and yes, bikes cost more than they did ten years ago. You want something new and genuinely fast, not a museum piece.
settings.pick: SP · SRAM Force AXS — electronic shifting, race-day spec
settings.upgrade: Make the math feel sane again: split it monthly with Affirm or use pre-tax HSA/FSA dollars through Truemed.

settings.title: Short course: pure speed
settings.text: Short races are decided on raw bike speed — every watt and every transition second counts.
settings.item1_why: The biggest aero upgrade you can make — add a wheelset with your bike and the discount applies automatically in the cart.
settings.item2_why: Drink without sitting up — hydration that lives between your arms.

settings.title: Long course: carry everything, lose nothing
settings.text: Half and full distance is a fueling contest on wheels — storage and hydration matter as much as aero.
settings.item1_why: Rear-mounted hydration that keeps you in position through hour five.
settings.item2_why: Top-tube and frame storage for race-day fueling, all in one place.
settings.item3_why: Race-week setups in a single add to cart.

settings.title: Train smarter between races
settings.text: The riders who PR are the ones who measure. Build the feedback loop.
settings.item1_why: Train and pace your races with real power numbers.
settings.item2_why: Hammerhead Karoo and Garmin head units that turn rides into data.
settings.item3_why: Know what's behind you on long solo training rides.
